svg.title: System loading — 30 animated demonstration logs
svg.desc: Fictional startup sequence. Thirty logs appear one at a time, covering API, sensors, Python, configuration, database, network, MQTT, Modbus, automation and access checks. Four textual progress bars load from zero to one hundred percent, changing from red to green on completion. The last message is System running. The 60.4-second sequence repeats. Reduced motion shows only System running. This is an illustration, not live monitoring.
